task_text: Someone with the flu needs a place to rest and recover. I need a room set up within 20 minutes — comfortable to rest in, with easy access to water and any basics they might need.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a glass of water and any light snacks, and pass them to R2 when it arrives.
central_instructions.R2: Go to the kitchen to receive water and snacks from R1, then deliver them to R3 in the bedroom.
central_instructions.R3: Set up the bedroom with the items received from R2, ensuring the room is comfortable for rest.
central_instructions.R4: Ensure the bathroom is stocked with essentials like tissues and hand sanitizer, and assist R3 if needed.
